body: setup writes alias.toc as '!./<rel>/scripts/gittoc'. Shell aliases run from the current worktree's top-level, and a local-only (info/exclude) vendored copy does not exist in a linked worktree, so the alias fails there although the CLI itself works via git-common-dir. Resolve the main worktree at run time (git worktree list --porcelain, first line) and keep the path relative so the repo stays movable. Upgrade an existing old-form alias in place; leave custom aliases alone.
title: git toc alias breaks in linked worktrees of local-only installs
